story.ch1.text: Started as a Social Media Intern at Harmony agency (Yektanet), where I learned the fundamentals of digital content creation, audience engagement, and platform-specific communication. This was where I began understanding what makes content relevant and worth engaging with.
story.ch1.title: *My First Steps* in Digital Marketing
story.ch2.label: ۱۴۰۰ – ۱۴۰۲ - From Posting to Storytelling
story.ch2.text: I owned the words; the team brought them to life. From campaign ideas and UX writing to website content and video scripts, every piece here was made with designers, animators and developers — I led the story behind it.
story.ch2.title: Beyond *the caption.*

story.ch3.text:
Our agency website needed a complete rebuild. I took the lead, turning it into an SEO-driven website that attracted new clients, including a long-term client who stayed with us for three years.

This was the first time I realized my role didn't have to end where my job description did.
story.ch3.title: We design sites for everyone. *Except ourselves.*
